set.body: From the S10.5 audit (finding F10, p0-s105 dab0649e). The jobs chip's Cancel and its status-bar mirror don't name which run they cancel (WCAG 2.4.6). Give both an accessible name naming the run and its job, via the shell VM and A11y.tabOrder, with a test.
set.title: A11y: name the run that the jobs chip's Cancel cancels
